observations.command: /bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- handoff ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' handoff.md && printf '\\n--- focus ---\\n' && find .rsp/focus.d/long-running-delivery -maxdepth 2 -type f -print -exec sed -n '1,240p' {} \\; && printf '\\n--- change ---\\n' && sed -n '1,320p' .rsp/changes/long-running-delivery.md && printf '\\n--- previous verification ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' .cache/previous-verification.json && printf '\\n--- files ---\\n' && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CONTEXT-MAP.md' -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g '*long-running-delivery*' -g 'src/device-id.mjs' -g 'test/device-id.test.mjs' -g 'package.json' -g 'mise.toml' -g '.mise.toml'"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '261,620p' .agents/skills/rsp/SKILL.md && printf '\\n--- source ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/device-id.mjs && printf '\\n--- tests ---\\n' && sed -n '1,280p' test/device-id.test.mjs && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && sed -n '1,200p' package.json && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- allowlist refs ---\\n' && rg -n \"manifest|allowlist|long-running-delivery|device-id\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.git/**'"'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check && git diff -- src/device-id.mjs test/device-id.test.mjs .rsp/changes/long-running-delivery.md && git status --short'
